newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: 16 reported killed in Angola plane crash.
newsitem.headline: 16 reported killed in Angola plane crash.

text.p: Sixteen people died when a Russian-made Antonov-12 aircraft crashed in northeastern Angola, the Portuguese news agency Lusa reported on Thursday.

It quoted Branco Ferreira, national director of civil aviation, as saying the accident in the diamond-rich Lunda Norte province early on Wednesday occurred as the pilot was attempting to land in dense fog.
Lusa said in the report from Luanda that the plane, which belonged to a private Angolan company, crashed 150 metres (yards) from Lucapa airstrip.
Civil aviation authorities did not know the nationality of the victims but presumed that the four-man crew were Russian and the remaining passengers were Angolan, Lusa said.
The plane was carrying an assortment of goods, Branco Ferreira said. The report gave no further details.
